title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP tasks can ask for missing information or authorisation
notes: claim 83: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: Hold: the risk rationale asserts that the existing policy covers only MCP requests, although Microsoft does not establish that exclusion and describes a policy layer that can apply across Work IQ experiences. The briefing also calls pause-and-resume a new task state without supporting documentation; the roadmap facts and published control paths and API operations check out.
